svg.title: Keep coupling partners together
svg.desc: Two windows over the same spectrum. In the first, both partners of a J coupling lie inside the window, so the spin system is complete and the prediction is valid. In the second the coupling partner falls outside the window, so that multiplet is out of distribution and its prediction is wrong.
svg.text: A window need not hold the whole molecule, but every proton coupling to a proton inside it must also be inside (≤ 1200 Hz).
